technology_name: METHOD FOR PREPARING HYDROPHOBIC GRAPHITIC CARBON NITRIDE-COATED NATURAL RUBBER FOAM FOR OIL-WATER SEPARATION
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Standard synthetic chemical sorbent booms are difficult to recycle, show low oil selectivity in volatile waters, and generate microplastic environmental pollutants.
description: A porous oil-absorbent matrix prepared by coating a natural rubber sponge substrate with a superhydrophobic, superoleophilic graphitic carbon nitride ($g\text{-}C_3N_4$) layer to enable efficient chemical absorption.
applications: Marine oil spill cleanup kits, industrial machinery wash basin filters, petroleum storage facility emergency kits, and maritime harbor bilge cleaners.
secondary_sector: Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Water, Environment & Waste Management
